description: This file implements resource grid mapping functions for 5G NR physical layer, including optimized handling for contiguous DM-RS Type 1 mapping, resource element block mapping, and overall resource grid mapping with support for precoding, resource allocation, and pattern-based resource element selection.

classes.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for resource grid mapping functions, supporting optimized DM-RS mapping and resource element placement with precoding.

methods.name: get_re_mask_type_1
methods.description: Returns the resource element mask pattern for PDSCH DM-RS type 1 based on CDM group ID.

methods.name: map_dmrs_type1_contiguous
methods.description: Performs optimized mapping of contiguous DM-RS Type 1 resources across resource blocks, applying precoding and resource element placement.

methods.name: map_re_block
methods.description: Maps a block of resource elements with precoding, handling contiguous and non-contiguous resource masks.

methods.name: resource_grid_mapper_impl::map
methods.description: Main function to map input resource symbols into the resource grid, supporting various patterns, precoding, and resource allocation, including special handling for DM-RS Type 1.
